outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes (N=4, n>100 cells), but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points are overlaid.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4, n>400), but individual data points are not shown, only bars with error bars.
Panel C is a western blot image; it is not a plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks for each genotype); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at each age); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot); this plot type is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel G shows immunofluorescence micrographs (Calbindin, DAPI, Merge); it is not a plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9) without individual data points overlaid on the bars.
